data.narrative:
Aurelius Systems is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Michael LaFramboise and John Marmaduke that has raised $10M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies across Defense & Security, including two public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private firms such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $10M raised as a base proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $25M. Peer-Median analysis across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M) produces a median of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $21M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $362M across the two methods. The wide spread reflects meaningful dispersion in the peer set; UFORCE's $1.0B Seed valuation pulls the peer median substantially higher than stage-progression logic alone would suggest. Key uncertainties include the degree to which Aurelius's technology, market position, and revenue trajectory align with high-value peers like UFORCE versus lower-valued comparables, and whether frontier-defense dynamics justify the upper end of the range.
